indicators.text: IODA BGP reachable prefixes or active-probing responsiveness drops >=25% below the 7-day rolling baseline for >=30 minutes.
Two or more countries sharing a submarine cable corridor experience concurrent BGP/probing drops >=20% within a 2-hour window.
OONI measurement aggregation shows confirmed blocking or anomaly rate >=15% across >=50 daily measurements in a country.
Single-probe or darknet-only drop with stable BGP prefix count and normal OONI reachability.
Cross-program tip: Elements seismic/volcanic alert or Wake vessel loitering anomaly within 50 km of a submarine cable corridor.

A watched provider network (AS14593 Starlink, AS16509 Amazon, AS8075 Microsoft, AS15169 Google, AS396982 Google Cloud) shows an IODA BGP or active-probing drop >=5% below the median of the 7 days before, over >=30 minutes. The window is IODA's own outage events on that network in the last 24 h, else the longest run of points >=5% low in the last 24 h, else the last 3 h.

A provider lists an open incident on its own status feed (AWS Health Dashboard RSS, Google Cloud and Google Workspace incidents.json, Azure status RSS, Microsoft 365's public status page, Apple System Status, Cloudflare Status, Akamai's and Zoom's incident history RSS, Slack Status, Starlink's Statuspage). Reported by the provider; Blackout does not assess its cause.
Two or more different watched providers start a BO-IND-6 drop or a BO-IND-7 incident within 2 hours of each other, inside the last 24 hours.

Cloudflare Radar's Outage Center lists an outage (annotated by Cloudflare's analysts from Cloudflare's own traffic, with the cause and type Cloudflare states), ongoing or ended within the last 72 h. Reported by Cloudflare; Blackout does not assess its cause.
Cloudflare Radar flags a traffic anomaly in its own traffic that Cloudflare has verified and no outage annotation covers, ongoing or ended within the last 72 h. Radar gives no cause.

Cloudflare Radar's BGP hijack detection lists an origin hijack at Cloudflare's high confidence (8 or above) seen by at least 25 of its route-collector peers, ongoing or last seen within 72 h. Reported by Cloudflare; Blackout does not assess intent.

Cloudflare Radar's route-leak detection lists a provider-customer-provider leak of at least 100 prefixes seen by at least 25 of its route-collector peers, ongoing or finished within 72 h. Reported by Cloudflare; Blackout does not assess intent.

The IAEA's newest numbered Ukraine update says the Zaporizhzhya Nuclear Power Plant is without off-site power or relies on a single off-site line (before the war it had ten). Reported by the IAEA and quoted; Blackout does not assess it.

ODIN's reporting utilities show more than 50,000 meters without power in a US state (the size of loss form DOE-417 makes reportable). Reported by the utilities through ODIN; only utilities that report to ODIN are counted. Blackout does not assess the cause.

A watched city's night radiance (NASA Black Marble, moon- and surface-corrected) on its newest clear night is 40% or more below the median of its clear nights in the 14 before. Blackout's measurement; it does not say why the city is darker.

A US balancing authority's hourly demand, as it reports it to EIA (EIA-930), runs 25% or more below what its own day-ahead forecast usually implies (further, where its forecasts often miss) for 3 hours in a row or more. Reported by the balancing authority; Blackout measures the gap and does not assess why.

warning_problems.title: Submarine cable cut or landing-station disruption
Provider-level outage at a major cloud, content or satellite internet provider
Routing integrity: a BGP origin hijack or route leak that can divert or blackhole a network's traffic
Loss of grid power to a population or to a nuclear site
